hotspots.title: US Midterm Election Rout & MAGA Internal Backlash
hotspots.blurb: A decisive Democratic sweep in the US midterm elections has triggered intense infighting within the MAGA movement and the broader Republican base. Figures across right-wing media are openly blaming Donald Trump, Vice President JD Vance, and foreign policy missteps like the war with Iran for the humiliating congressional losses, calling into question the future of Trumpism.
hotspots.affect: Drives white-hot affective investment as conservative commentators and officials grapple with defeat through internal recriminations, panic over political oblivion, and bitter factional blame-shifting.

hotspots.title: Polish Constitutional Court Crisis & Coup Accusations
hotspots.blurb: Tensions between Prime Minister Donald Tusk and Law and Justice (PiS) leader Jarosław Kaczyński have reached a boiling point over control of the Constitutional Tribunal. Kaczyński and PiS allies accuse Tusk of orchestrating an unconstitutional coup and operating an 'organized criminal group' within the court system, while PiS mobilizes protests and legal actions against the government's judicial overhaul.
hotspots.affect: Commands extreme affective charge through hyper-polarized rhetoric of a state coup, constitutional illegitimacy, and criminal accusations exchanged between top leaders.

hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: In the wake of Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential election defeat to Lula, his sudden departure to the United States and appearance at Mar-a-Lago have touched off severe political backlash in Brazil and Washington. US Democratic lawmakers are calling for his immediate deportation amid money-laundering probes, while Brazilian opponents challenge the legitimacy of his ongoing Senate pay and remote voting.
hotspots.affect: Generates intense heat around themes of elite impunity, flight from justice, and the unraveling authority of the Bolsonaro political family.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Rassemblement National's annual congress and Jordan Bardella's high-profile launch of his new book 'Gouverner' have triggered fierce debate over the party's readiness to take power in France. Media exclusions at launch events, anti-far-right protests, and public snubs from conservative rivals like Bruno Retailleau highlight escalating contention over the 2027 presidential race.
hotspots.affect: Commands strong media heat through polarized debate over far-right normalization, media bans, and contentious presidential posturing.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei Madrid Visit & Vox Alliance
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei stirred international controversy by traveling to Madrid for the Ibero-American Summit while conspicuously avoiding official protocol meetings with King Felipe VI and Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. Instead, Milei focused his agenda on a high-visibility bilateral meeting with Vox leader Santiago Abascal, reinforcing transatlantic far-right ties.
hotspots.affect: Elicits strong emotional investment through diplomatic provocation, ideological combativeness, and polarized coverage of far-right transnational solidarity.
